items.name: CMI Tessellate Cube Open 2018
items.information: Online registrations will be done on WCA with payment at the given link. This is the only acceptable form of online registration. Registration is Free for all CMI students. Please mention your ID number in the comments while registering as proof. There will be NO On-Spot Registration at the venue. You must have a WCA ID (except new competitors) and a valid email. Please check the Payment Tab for all details. Reporting Desk shall be open 8:00-8:30am for 3x3x3Blindfold and FMC and 8:30-9:00am for other events. Those not arriving on time may not be allowed to do their solves. Please bring govt./employer/educational photo ID card for institutional documentation. Lunch coupons can be purchased at Reporting Desk.

items.name: Don't Peek 2018
items.information: This competition is focused on the BLD, fewest moves and big cube events. **Keep in mind that you need to stay quiet during the BLD events to not disturb the competitors. If you're participating in the competition you are expected to help out with judging, scrambling, running etc. to keep the competition running smoothly.** Spectators are welcome though most of the event that are held are pretty long and boring to watch. There will be a competitor limit of 40 persons and the entry fee is set to 50 SEK. Check out the other tabs for more details.

items.name: Please Be Quiet LA 2018

venue.name: [University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)](http://www.ucla.edu/)
venue.address: 345 Portola Plaza, Los Angeles, CA 90095, USA

items.information: This competition is being organized by Cubing Club at UCLA. All UCLA students may register free of charge; the fee is $14 for everyone else. There will be a competitor limit of 25, and no walk-in registrations. Spectators may attend for free, but must be quiet as the events being held require a lot of concentration on the part of the competitors. If you are a UCLA student looking to attend a local competition but can't do the blindfolded events, note that we are planning another competition in the spring with more standard events such as 3x3x3 and pyraminx. Don't be afraid to show up to this one for a bit to spectate and/or help us out! **Please note that no food is allowed in the classroom.**
